title: Liquid Gated Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.30695v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world time series often exhibit irregular sampling and extended temporal horizons, requiring models to capture continuous-time dynamics across arbitrary intervals without prohibitive scaling costs. Discrete-time methods collapse variable time intervals into static positional steps; solver-dependent continuous-time models preserve temporal structure but rely on sequential integration, precluding parallelization; and solver-free approximations avoid this cost yet none couples observed time intervals with input-driven state modulation. We propose Liquid Gated Attention (LGA), a solver-free parallel temporal operator. By parameterizing an input-driven gating mechanism with observed time intervals, LGA introduces a continuous-time inductive bias and formulates hidden state evolution as a fast-weight associative memory, enabling parallel computation across the temporal dimension. translated_abstract: 现实世界的时间序列通常表现出不规则采样和较长的时域跨度，这要求模型能够在任意时间区间上捕捉连续时间动力学，同时不产生过高的扩展成本。离散时间方法将可变的时间间隔压缩为静态的位置步长；依赖求解器的连续时间模型虽然保留了时间结构，但依赖顺序积分，无法并行化；无求解器的近似方法虽然避免了这一成本，却没有一种方法能将观测到的时间间隔与输入驱动的状态调制相结合。我们提出了液体门控注意力（LGA），这是一种无求解器的并行时间算子。通过用观测到的时间间隔对输入驱动的门控机制进行参数化，LGA 引入了连续时间的归纳偏置，并将隐藏状态演化表述为快速权重联想记忆，从而实现时间维度上的并行计算。利用非因果编码中的矩阵结合律和预……
tldr: 提出液体门控注意力（LGA），一种无求解器的并行时间算子，通过将观测时间间隔与输入驱动门控机制相结合，引入连续时间归纳偏置，并将隐藏状态演化建模为快速权重联想记忆，从而实现时间维度上的高效并行计算。
en_tdlr: Liquid Gated Attention (LGA) is a solver-free parallel temporal operator that couples observed time intervals with input-driven gating, introducing a continuous-time inductive bias and formulating hidden state evolution as fast-weight associative memory to enable parallel computation across the temporal dimension.
